summary.text: Dave Thomas is the Republican candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 36 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Anthony Ealy.
Ballotpedia lists him as a U.S. Army veteran and chaplain.

paragraphs.text: Dave Thomas was born in Indio, California, and served in the U.S. Army from 1970 to 1973.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working as a chaplain.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Thomas described himself as a veteran, family man and retired locomotive engineer who has been married for 48 years and has four children and seven grandchildren in Jackson County.
